crossRefs.note: Yahweh’s word came to me the second time, saying, “What do you see?” I said, “I see a boiling cauldron; and it is…
Then Yahweh said to me, “Out of the north, evil will break out on all the inhabitants of the land.

translations.web: Out of his nostrils a smoke goes, as of a boiling pot over a fire of reeds.
translations.bsb: Smoke billows from his nostrils as from a boiling pot over burning reeds.
translations.kjv: Out of his nostrils goeth smoke, as out of a seething pot or caldron.
translations.asv: Out of his nostrils a smoke goeth, As of a boiling pot and burning rushes.
